summary: Capacitor apps now build for iPhone and Android, and Mission Control shows one count you can trust.
notes: launchpad now builds Capacitor apps: a signed Android release for Google Play and an iPhone archive, with your web app inside.
Mission Control shows the same count everywhere: the banner, the progress bar and the Checklist tab.
After you buy a key, a notice says what it added and why your Remaining number went up.
Your free build stays with the app you started it in, and it only asks for keys the parts it builds actually use.
If a launchpad settings file gets damaged, launchpad keeps it aside instead of overwriting it, so your saved keys and apps aren't lost.

beta.summary: Every card shows one clear way to do it, and new versions arrive as a proper update window.
notes: Each to-do shows the quickest way first; other ways sit under one fold, each marked as an alternative.
A card launchpad can do itself says so, with one Do it button.
New versions open a window with the release notes and Update now, Later or Skip this version.
A newer update is never hidden behind an older notice.
Buys through a test checkout: you are not charged.
